X.t0_detection_limit: First game-world/HUD frame at inspected onset, distinguished from console/harness and Godot splash. Full earlier timeline was sampled previously, not a new exhaustive per-frame replay.

30_second.findings: Transport/economy genre and construction controls are understandable: R/T plus tile click/drag, funds, cities and time speed. At +30s railway mode/cost is visible. However this window does not clearly communicate a concrete player objective, success criterion or reason to choose one link; dense raw logs compete with explanation. This is a failure of the combined objective/value/operation onboarding criterion, not total incomprehensibility.

5_minute.findings: Construction feedback exists: by +60s railway count 29, road count 4, funds 468 rather than 500; networks grow and war/economy state changes. World-reactive transport is a plausible continuation hook. At +300s player company still shows route 0 and profit +0.0. A completed player build→economic result→next decision loop or retry result has not been established.
5_minute.limitations: Autonomous world changes are not credited as player-caused results. No specification was read.

debug_dependency.findings: In-game construction prompts exist. Seed, v0.2, Test operation, Force war and raw event logs are visible. Developer-facing presentation is established; successful play requiring debug controls is not.

shelf.findings: Flat colored circles/tiles and dense small text provide little immediate player challenge or visual invitation. The changing-world transport premise has potential, but the first image does not clearly sell that value.
shelf.limitations: Visual model judgment of supplied game image; no store page, competitor study or human choice experiment.

price_blind_product.findings: Debug controls, unprioritized logs, clipped content and unclear player outcome read as an internal simulation prototype. Functioning state changes are a positive component, not proof of finished product quality.
price_blind_product.limitations: Title/IP/price removed; no market demand, sales, global QA, rights or release claim.

Y.t0_detection_limit: First game-world/HUD frame at inspected onset, distinguished from console/harness and Godot splash. Full earlier timeline was sampled previously, not a new exhaustive per-frame replay.

continuity.findings: At 40s and 79s game view is replaced by engine-dark screen, at 80s Godot splash appears, and later game time has reset to Day1 08:00. Thus t0-relative 30s/5min windows cross restart activity and cannot establish a single continuous first run.
continuity.limitations: Exact full restart intervals not exhaustively localized; recording interruption is not labeled a game crash without cause evidence.

30_second.findings: An immediate objective is readable: speak with the contact at base; medical transport/rescue jobs have deadlines. F report and E vehicle entry are contextual prompts. But near-black world visibility, HUD overlap/clipping and poorly communicated movement/navigation obstruct the complete first-use presentation.
30_second.limitations: Window crosses restart; no human confusion/comprehension was measured.

5_minute.findings: Distance and mode change, vehicle exit message, resource changes, NPC warning/fear and a new rescue objective provide screen feedback and a possible social consequence hook. At +300s the objective remains in progress; no rescue/delivery completion, explicit failure or retry result is established. Restarts break first-run continuity.
5_minute.limitations: Goal change alone is not proof of successful prior completion, and input causality is not fully certified.

debug_dependency.findings: Goal and contextual keys are available in game. Raw faction identifiers, NPC lists and crowded panels give diagnostic presentation. Neither mandatory debug use nor independent human navigation success is established.

shelf.findings: Near-black world, barely discernible actors/locations, overlapped blocks and large textual overlays obscure the image. Rescue/transport and vehicle premises are inferable but not clearly presented as an inviting play experience.
shelf.limitations: No store page or actual human selection test.

price_blind_product.findings: World visibility and overlapping/clipped HUD plus raw NPC lists read as an internal gameplay slice. Contextual action/status responses exist, but a finished player-facing product is not demonstrated.
price_blind_product.limitations: Does not assert absent content outside the recording; no sales forecast.
